title: [Master] Different source reference on reservation entries created directly from Job Planning Line and via a warehouse pick.
summary: Reservation entries created from job planning lines now maintain consistent source references whether created directly or through warehouse picks, with upgrade logic to migrate existing data.
key_points: Ensures reservation entries from job planning lines have matching source references regardless of creation method
Adds upgrade logic to migrate existing reservation entries to use consistent references
Updates warehouse activity and job warehouse management processes to maintain source reference consistency
Includes extensive test coverage for inventory picks and warehouse picks on job planning lines
Manages item tracking and reference resolution across multiple warehousing scenarios
